versions.subject: [OSCD] Always Install Elevated Alternative
versions.detection:
integrity_level:
    IntegrityLevel: 'System'
user:
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
image_1:
    Image|contains|all: 
        - '\Windows\Installer\'
        - 'msi'
    Image|endswith: 
        - 'tmp'
image_2:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\msiexec.exe'
condition: (image_1 and user) or (image_2 and user and integrity_level)
versions.spl: (Image="*\\Windows\\Installer\\*" Image="*msi*" Image="*tmp" User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM") OR (Image="*\\msiexec.exe" User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM" IntegrityLevel="System")
